bug_description: Sequential fetching adds the latency of each due subscription. This revision measures normal startup through automatic all-feed refresh under a declared 1.5-second RSS response delay. It does not claim lower CPU time; the original CPU-negative result is archived.
fix_summary: Fetch due feeds using four bounded workers and add each completed inserted count after await, preserving totals under out-of-order completion.

test_oracle.definition: Elapsed normal startup including all-feed refresh under identical 1.5-second RSS response latency. Every unfixed lower timing bound must exceed 1.5 times its paired fixed upper bound; native CPU is diagnostic only.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed conservative lower bound >= 1.5 * fixed upper bound over 3 paired rounds
test_oracle.workload_notes: Measure complete ordinary startup and automatic all-feed refresh under identical declared 1.5-second RSS response latency. All three conservative lower/upper paired ratios must reach 1.5x. Native scheduling is diagnostic; Concurrent inserted totals are corrected.
